promo-di-dead.title: Tap the envelope. Nothing. #shorts
promo-di-dead.description:
Same design. Download it as a PNG, drop it in the group chat. A guest taps the envelope — nothing happens. Taps the words, tap to open — nothing.

Try the fancier version: an MP4 with the envelope animating open. It plays, it looks great, and the reply button at the end can't be tapped.

Canva's own help page says it in so many words: "Hyperlinks will not work on PNGs, JPGs, MP4s, etc., or when you post your design on social media."

Send the link, not the picture.

promo-di-pdf.title: The wrong PDF kills the link #shorts
promo-di-pdf.description:
If someone needs a file instead of a link — an email to an older relative, or a printer — download a PDF.

Canva's help page: "Hyperlinks will only work if you download your design as a PDF (except flattened PDFs)."

So choose the standard PDF, not the flattened one, and the envelope still opens.
